class.name: UZUPBRFromImage
class.brief_description: Estimates PBR maps from a single texture image.
class.description: From one texture photograph, [UZUPBRFromImage] estimates the maps a PBR material needs: an albedo with the baked light removed, a normal map from the image's own brightness, an ORM map (ambient occlusion in cavities, roughness per material kind, metallic) and a height map. The per-kind values were fitted against Poly Haven scans in the prototype; the premise is honest: a normal map estimated from one image measures about as close to a real scan as a flat normal does, so the output is a starting point, not a scan. An externally estimated normal map can replace the brightness-based one, ideally after [UZUMapImport] has checked it. [b]Note:[/b] This class is specific to U.ZU Engine (U.ZU Picture).

method.name: compare
method.description: Measures a normal map against a reference (e.g. a scan): returns the mean angular error in degrees, plus the same error for a flat normal as the honest baseline. With [param rough] and [param ref_rough] (ORM maps), also reports the roughness means and their correlation.

method.name: kinds
method.description: Returns the fitted per-kind table: for each kind name, a [Dictionary] with [code]strength[/code], [code]rough[/code], [code]spread[/code], [code]metal[/code] and [code]detail[/code].

method.name: make
method.description: Generates the maps from [param image]. Returns a [Dictionary] with [code]"albedo"[/code], [code]"normal"[/code], [code]"orm"[/code] and [code]"height"[/code] images, the [code]"stats"[/code] of the estimate and any [code]"warnings"[/code], or [code]"ok" = false[/code] with an [code]"error"[/code]. [param strength] multiplies the kind's fitted normal strength, [param delight] (0 to 1) how strongly the baked light is removed, [param tile] wraps the estimation around the edges, [param invert] treats dark as high, and [param normal_from] replaces the brightness-based normal map.

method.name: make_file
method.description: Like [method make] with files: loads [param in_path], writes [code]albedo.png[/code], [code]normal.png[/code], [code]orm.png[/code], [code]height.png[/code] and a [code]material.tres[/code] (an [ORMMaterial3D] using the maps) into [param out_dir]. Returns the same [Dictionary] with [code]"files"[/code] in place of the images.
